title: Treat missing thumbnail source assets as non-retryable
answers: Should thumbnail preparation retry when the analysis asset is gone?
Why does thumbnail generation keep retrying a deleted source asset?
How should deterministic thumbnail preparation failures be reported?
body:
Symptom: Thumbnail preparation retries even though its analysis asset has been deleted and cannot supply a frame.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/activities/observation_media.py:prepare_observation_thumbnail_activity previously let ExportedAsset.DoesNotExist escape from the asset lookup without marking the failure non-retryable.
Fix pattern: Convert deterministic missing-input failures into ApplicationError(non_retryable=True), preserving the original exception as the cause; an absent rendered-object location follows the same non-retryable convention.
Constraints: The lookup remains scoped by analysis_asset_id and team_id. An empty content location is terminal because the analysis render has already finished; this classification does not apply to transient database failures.
applies: Analysis asset lookup and rendered-object validation during observation thumbnail preparation.
